Hi Samira — nice to meet you over email. Per Dylan and Ben's notes, attached is a proposed redline for the publicity and confidentiality sections. Key points in plain language: 

- Pilot quiet period: during the pilot term, Redwood will not issue press releases or publish customer case studies referencing Oda Corp without Oda's prior written consent.
- Post-GA: for customers that transition to general availability and meet mutual marketing criteria, Redwood may provide notice of the relationship after a 30-day notice window unless otherwise agreed.
- Logo use: any use of Oda Corp trademarks or logos requires pre-approval of the specific asset and context; we will maintain an approved asset list and an internal review turn-around of 5 business days.
- Reference rights: Redwood may list Oda Corp as a "Customer of Redwood Inference" on marketing materials (web/one-liners) without attribution; any quotations, case studies, or detailed descriptions require explicit written consent.

Redline attached: OrderForm_ODAC_v1.3.pdf (tracked changes). Also attached is a short appendix we can include: "Logo & Reference Attachment A" with sample language. If that looks good I can convert to final Order Form language and send to your counsel.

Proposed next steps:
1) Samira to confirm preference (A) mutual consent for pilot OR (B) mutual consent + channel list.
2) If (B), Laura to add a short allowed-channels list (press release, joint webinar, case study) and a signature line for marketing approvals.
3) We circulate final redline and DocuSign link.

Thanks — Laura
